name: deal-recovery
description: Learn from past deal recoveries and propose relevant next steps for rep-approved HubSpot tasks.

interface.shortDescription: Turn past deal lessons into useful next steps.
interface.longDescription: Build a shared recovery catalog from selected troubled-but-won deals, review open deals against it, and create useful HubSpot tasks after the rep approves the specific proposals. Includes setup guidance for optional recurring reviews. The rep carries out the work.
defaultPrompt: Build a recovery catalog from historical deals I select.
Review open deals using my saved recovery catalog.
Set up a recurring review that proposes tasks for my approval.
